Investigating Autoregressive and Machine Learning-based Time Series Modeling with Dielectric Spectroscopy for Predicting Quality of Biofabricated Constructs

High AI for Bioprinting openalex Direct Read now in_vitro Exp. validation
Shohanuzzaman Shohan, Mahmud Hasan, Binil Starly, Rohan A. Shirwaiker Manufacturing Letters 2022-09-01 10.1016/j.mfglet.2022.07.110
单位: Comparative Medicine Institute, North Carolina State University, Raleigh, NC 27695, United States of America
通讯: Rohan A. Shirwaiker @ Comparative Medicine Institute, North Carolina State University, Raleigh, NC 27695, United States of America
相关性: 该论文直接利用机器学习时间序列模型预测生物打印构建体的质量，与AI用于生物打印的过程监控高度相关。
边界: The paper only focuses on prediction and does not implement closed-loop control or autonomous decision-making to advance from observation to action.
动机· 利用时间序列建模提高生物制造中基于介电谱的质量预测效率与准确性。
方法· 对比自回归模型与ML模型（SVM, ANN, CNN, LSTM）预测Δε趋势。
结果· LSTM在预测Δε时均方误差最低，表现最优。
验证· 通过含hASC的GelMA水凝胶11天体外培养验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To enhance quality monitoring in biofabrication by applying time series modeling to dielectric spectroscopy data for early detection of deviations.
Method· Standard autoregressive models and ML models (SVM, ANN, CNN, LSTM) were compared for forecasting the dielectric metric Δε during construct maturation.
Result· LSTM yielded the lowest mean square error in Δε predictions, demonstrating superior performance among tested models.
Validation· Validation was performed using in vitro culture of GelMA hydrogels encapsulating human adipose-derived stem cells over 11 days.

Build surface study of single-layer raster scanning in selective laser melting: Surface roughness prediction using deep learning

Medium AM Biomedical Materials openalex Transferable Save for project mechanical_testing Exp. validation
Behzad Fotovvati, Kevin Chou Manufacturing Letters 2022-09-01 10.1016/j.mfglet.2022.07.088
单位: Additive Manufacturing Institute of Science and Technology (AMIST), University of Louisville, Louisville, KY 40292, USA
通讯: Behzad Fotovvati @ Additive Manufacturing Institute of Science and Technology (AMIST), University of Louisville, Louisville, KY 40292, USA
相关性: 该论文研究了SLM工艺参数对Ti6Al4V表面粗糙度的影响，并使用机器学习进行预测，对生物医学植入物的表面质量优化有参考价值。
边界: This paper does not link surface roughness to implant-specific outcomes such as stress shielding, fatigue, or osseointegration, and lacks any biomedical context or mechanical testing beyond surface profilometry.
动机· 解决SLM工艺中表面粗糙度预测困难的问题。
方法· 设计单层光栅扫描实验，用白光干涉仪测量粗糙度，训练反向传播神经网络预测模型。
结果· 激光功率是影响表面粗糙度的最主要参数，层厚贡献10%-15%的变异，模型预测R²达98.8%。
验证· 通过216组训练数据和32组测试数据验证预测精度。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To address the challenge of poor predictability and high variability of surface finish in selective laser melting (SLM) parts.
Method· A fractional factorial design was used to fabricate single-layer raster scanning Ti6Al4V samples, surface roughness was measured by white-light interferometry, and a back-propagation neural network was trained on 216 datasets to predict roughness from process parameters.
Result· Laser power was found to be the most significant parameter; layer thickness contributed 10%–15% to roughness variation, and the ML model achieved a coefficient of determination of 98.8% on a separate test set of 32 samples.
Validation· The model was validated using held-out experimental data from 32 distinct parameter combinations.
selective laser melting · 选区激光熔化surface roughness · 表面粗糙度machine learning · 机器学习process parameters · 工艺参数Ti6Al4V · 钛合金Ti6Al4Vback-propagation · 反向传播white-light interferometry · 白光干涉测量

Investigating the effect of powder recoater blade material on the mechanical properties of parts manufactured using a powder-bed fusion process

Medium AM Biomedical Materials openalex Peripheral Skim only mechanical_testing Exp. validation
Haley Fox, Abishek B. Kamaraj, Dana Drake Manufacturing Letters 2022-09-01 10.1016/j.mfglet.2022.07.071
单位: EOS North America, 28970 Cabot Drive #700, Novi, MI 48377, USA
通讯: Haley Fox @ EOS North America, 28970 Cabot Drive #700, Novi, MI 48377, USA
相关性: 该论文研究粉末床熔融过程中刮刀材料对零件力学性能的影响，虽涉及点阵结构但未讨论应力遮挡或骨整合，与生物医学植入物方向关联较弱。
边界: No evaluation of stress shielding, fatigue, surface roughness, or osseointegration; lacks biomedical context.
动机· 比较不同刮刀材料对粉末床熔融零件力学性能的影响
方法· 采用拉伸、压缩和光学密度分析测试不同刮刀制成的零件
结果· 刮刀类型对拉伸强度无显著影响，但橡胶刮刀导致更多大缺陷，HSS刮刀韧性更稳定
验证· 通过力学测试和缺陷分析进行实验验证
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· This study investigates how different recoater blade materials affect the mechanical properties and defect distribution of powder bed fusion parts.
Method· Tensile bars, cubes, and Voronoi lattice pucks were fabricated with high-speed steel, silicone rubber, and carbon fiber brush blades, and tested for tensile properties, optical density, and compression strength/toughness.
Result· Blade type did not significantly affect tensile strength; rubber blades produced more large defects (>75 μm) while HSS blades yielded more consistent toughness with half the standard deviation.
Validation· Mechanical testing (tensile and compression) and optical defect analysis provided experimental validation.

Developing scaling laws to predict compressive mechanical properties and determine geometrical parameters of modified BCC lattice structures

Medium AM Biomedical Materials openalex Transferable Skim only simulation_case
Hasanain Abdulhadi, Abdalsalam Fadeel, Tahseen A. Alwattar, Ahsan Mian Engineering Reports 2022-09-01 10.1002/eng2.12566
单位: Department of Mechanical and Material Engineering Wright State University Dayton Ohio USA
通讯: Ahsan Mian @ Department of Mechanical and Material Engineering Wright State University Dayton Ohio USA
相关性: 该论文研究了BCC点阵结构的力学性能预测，但未涉及生物医学植入物、应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
边界: No LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing, no fatigue analysis, no surface roughness or osseointegration data.
动机· 建立预测点阵结构压缩力学性能和几何参数的通用经验公式。
方法· 基于117个BCC变体模型的有限元分析，拟合Gibson-Ashby标度律。
结果· 经验公式能准确预测点阵特性，且增大支柱角度使变形机制从弯曲主导转向拉伸主导。
验证· 仅通过有限元数值模拟验证，无实验验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To develop generalized empirical closed-form equations for predicting compressive mechanical properties and geometrical parameters of modified BCC lattice structures.
Method· 117 finite element models with varying strut angles, relative densities, and design sets were analyzed in ABAQUS to fit scaling laws relating relative modulus and stress to relative density.
Result· The derived equations accurately predict lattice characteristics; increasing strut angle shifts deformation from bending-dominated to stretch-dominated behavior.
Validation· Validation was performed solely through finite element simulations without experimental testing.

Building Orientation and Heat Treatments Effect on the Pseudoelastic Properties of NiTi Produced by LPBF

Medium AM Biomedical Materials openalex Transferable Save for project mechanical_testing Exp. validation
Giovanni Carlucci, L. Patriarca, Ali Gökhan Demir, Jannis Nicolas Lemke, Alberto Coda et al. Shape Memory and Superelasticity 2022-09-01 10.1007/s40830-022-00391-0
单位: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Politecnico di Milano, Via La Masa 1, 20156, Milan, Italy
通讯: Giovanni Carlucci @ Department of Mechanical Engineering, Politecnico di Milano, Via La Masa 1, 20156, Milan, Italy
相关性: 该论文研究了LPBF工艺参数和后处理对NiTi形状记忆合金伪弹性性能的影响，与用户关注的AM生物医学植入物方向相关，但未涉及多孔结构或应力屏蔽。
边界: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue testing, or osseointegration, which are core to the user's direction.
动机· 优化LPBF制备NiTi的功能性能，利用构建取向和热处理。
方法· 对LPBF制备的NiTi进行拉伸和压缩力学测试，评估热处理和构建取向的影响。
结果· 热处理后拉伸和压缩的相变应变分别达到2.7%和4.6%。
验证· 通过单轴力学实验验证伪弹性性能。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To optimize the functional performance of NiTi produced by Laser Powder Bed Fusion by leveraging building orientation and post-processing heat treatments.
Method· Uniaxial tensile and compression tests were performed on LPBF-fabricated NiTi samples to evaluate the effects of different heat treatment schedules and building orientations on pseudoelastic behavior.
Result· Transformation strains up to 2.7% in tension and 4.6% in compression were achieved after optimized heat treatments.
Validation· Mechanical testing (tension and compression) was used to validate the pseudoelastic properties.

Design of patient specific basal dental implant using Finite Element method and Artificial Neural Network technique.

Sandeep Choudhury, Masud Rana, Arindam Chakraborty, Santanu Majumder, Sandipan Roy et al. Proceedings of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers. Part H, Journal of engineering in medicine 2022-09-01 10.1177/09544119221114729
单位: Department of Aerospace Engineering and Applied Mechanics, Indian Institute of Engineering Science and Technology, Howrah, West Bengal, India.
通讯: Shubhabrata Datta @ Department of Mechanical Engineering, SRM Institute of Science and Technology, Kattankulathur, Tamil Nadu, India. [推断]
相关性: 该论文针对种植体设计问题，利用有限元数据构建ANN代理模型并结合遗传算法优化，方法可迁移至植入物生物力学设计与代理建模方向。
边界: This paper does not include uncertainty quantification, experimental validation, or hip implant mechanics; its surrogate method is tailored to dental implant design.
动机· 针对不同骨条件设计患者特异性基牙种植体以改善骨整合环境。
方法· 结合Taguchi实验设计、有限元分析和人工神经网络代理模型，并用遗传算法优化种植体参数。
结果· 代理模型能准确预测微应变，优化后的种植体在不同骨条件下提供适宜的力学环境。
验证· 通过有限元模拟验证代理模型和优化结果。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To design patient-specific basal dental implants that promote osseointegration across varying bone conditions.
Method· They combined Taguchi design of experiments, finite element analysis, and an artificial neural network surrogate model, then used a genetic algorithm to optimize implant parameters.
Result· The surrogate model accurately predicted peri-implant microstrain, and the optimized implants achieved a mechanical environment favorable for osseointegration under different bone conditions.
Validation· The surrogate model and optimization results were validated through finite element simulations.

Dehao Liu, Yan Wang Manufacturing Letters 2022-09-01 10.1016/j.mfglet.2022.07.101
单位: Department of Mechanical Engineering, State University of New York at Binghamton, Binghamton, NY 13902, United States
通讯: Dehao Liu @ Department of Mechanical Engineering, State University of New York at Binghamton, Binghamton, NY 13902, United States
相关性: 该论文将物理约束神经网络与贝叶斯优化结合用于增材制造工艺设计，其方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的代理模型构建与多目标优化。
边界: This paper focuses on metal additive manufacturing process optimization (dendritic growth) rather than biomedical implant design or biomechanical FEA surrogate modeling.
动机· 解决金属增材制造工艺优化中高维过程-结构关系建模的挑战。
方法· 提出混合物理数据驱动框架，结合多物理场模拟、物理约束神经网络和贝叶斯优化。
结果· 成功构建了单枝晶生长的代理模型，并通过加权聚合实现多目标优化，获得Pareto前沿。
验证· 通过单枝晶生长模拟案例验证框架可行性，无实验验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To address the high-dimensional process-structure-property relationships in metal additive manufacturing for efficient process optimization.
Method· A hybrid framework integrating mesoscale multiphysics simulation, physics-constrained neural network surrogate, and multi-objective Bayesian optimization via weighted aggregation.
Result· The surrogate accurately predicts dendritic area and microsegregation, and the optimization yields Pareto front and processing map for desired microstructures.
Validation· Validation is performed through simulation case studies of single dendritic growth of Ti-6Al-4V, without experimental confirmation.

Jungho Kim, Sang‐ri Yi, Junho Song Structural Safety 2022-09-01 10.1016/j.strusafe.2022.102268
单位: Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering, Seoul National University, Seoul, Republic of Korea
通讯: Junho Song @ Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering, Seoul National University, Seoul, Republic of Korea
相关性: 该论文提出的主动学习异方差高斯过程方法可用于结构可靠性中的小概率估计，其框架可迁移至生物力学中的失效概率预测。
边界: This paper focuses on stochastic wind excitation and first-passage probability in civil engineering, with no biomedical context, implant mechanics, or FEA surrogate for implant design.
动机· 高效估计随机激励下结构首次穿越概率，避免昂贵蒙特卡洛模拟。
方法· 提出主动学习异方差高斯过程代理模型，自适应选择训练点。
结果· 方法在数值算例中显著降低计算成本，准确估计小概率。
验证· 通过两个随机振动数值算例验证精度与效率。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To efficiently estimate first-passage probability under stochastic excitations while avoiding expensive Monte Carlo simulations.
Method· An active-learning-based heteroscedastic Gaussian process surrogate model is proposed to adaptively select training points for accurate tail probability estimation.
Result· The method significantly reduces computational cost while maintaining accurate estimation of small failure probabilities in numerical examples.
Validation· Validation is performed on two numerical examples of stochastic vibration systems.

动机· 开发兼具生物相容性和机械稳定性的生物墨水用于构建可移植结构。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To develop biocompatible bioinks with adequate mechanical properties for fabricating stable constructs suitable for transplantation.
Method· Artificial channels were bioprinted using a porcine pancreatic dECM-based bioink, and the adhesion of endothelial cells and fibroblasts seeded via two methods was evaluated under flow conditions.
Result· Parallel fiber orientation combined with direct cell seeding and 5-hour incubation yielded the highest cell adhesion efficiency, with uniform distribution and sustained viability over 8 days.
Validation· Cell adhesion and distribution were validated by hematoxylin and eosin staining and cell count assays after 8 days in culture.

Motivation· To report treatment protocols and outcomes for culture-negative periprosthetic joint infections after total hip arthroplasty.

Result· Infection control was achieved in all patients with a 100% infection-free rate at an average follow-up of 7.5 years.
Validation· Clinical case series with long-term follow-up.

Motivation· To compare the influence of different intracortical width measurement methods on the Canal Flare Index (CFI) and femoral categorization in dogs.
Method· CFI values were calculated using different intracortical width measurements at the lesser trochanter level, and the resulting femoral categorizations were compared.
Result· Different measurement methods yielded significantly different CFI values and altered femoral categorization.
Validation· No experimental validation; statistical comparison of measurement methods only.

边界: No biomechanics modeling, no implant stress shielding or micromotion quantification, no FEA, no contact mechanics.
动机· 评估全关节置换术前低剂量全身影像中偶然发现的临床意义。
方法· 回顾性分析2183例患者术前影像报告，分类并追踪后续处理。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To determine the incidence and clinical significance of incidental findings on preoperative low-dose full-body imaging in total joint arthroplasty patients.
Method· A retrospective review of 2,183 patients' radiographic reports classified incidental findings by region and tracked additional imaging, delays, or cancellations.
Result· Incidental findings occurred in 1.9% of cases, with only 0.7% requiring further imaging; few cases were delayed and none cancelled.
Validation· Retrospective cohort study with level III evidence, no experimental validation.

Motivation· Prolonged sitting is linked to low back pain, and chair design may influence posture and movement patterns.
Method· A within-subjects study examined the effects of armrest adjustments and tilt mechanisms on user-chair interfacial pressure and micromotion during computer tasks.
Result· Proper armrest adjustments increased average displacement and in-chair movements, potentially reducing low back pain.
Validation· Preliminary findings with no specific validation approach reported.

Motivation· To compare 1-year health-related quality of life improvements among patients undergoing single-level lumbar fusion, total hip arthroplasty, and total knee arthroplasty.
Method· Retrospective cohort study collecting preoperative and 1-year postoperative HRQOL measures including SF-12 PCS and MCS.
